item.name: BE Fixes Verification (2026-09-14)
item.description: Run `php artisan fursa:seed-postman-accounts` once against the environment you point base_url at, then run this folder top-to-bottom (Collection Runner or click Send in order). Every request is pre-filled with real data and chains into the next via collection variables — nothing to edit by hand.

item.name: 4. BE-46 & BE-47 — certificate auth, ownership and learning-type gating
4.1 GET my certificates as myself (volunteer) — works

exec: pm.test('authenticated owner can read their own certificates', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 4.2 GET my certificates with no token — now rejected (BE-46)
4.3 Create a Course opportunity WITHOUT certificate_type_id — rejected (BE-47)

exec: pm.test('course without certificate_type_id is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: 4.4 Create a non-certificate-type opportunity WITH certificate_type_id — rejected (BE-47)

exec: pm.test('non course/internship type cannot carry a certificate_type_id', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: 5. BE-48 & BE-49 — My Calendar save/unsave, calendar_id, event support
5.1 Save the sanitized opportunity to My Calendar (volunteer)
5.2 Re-fetch the opportunity — is_saved_to_calendar + calendar_id now present (BE-48)

exec: pm.test('calendar_id is a real id, not null', () => pm.expect(body.calendar_id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('calendar_id'))));

item.name: 5.3 Save it again (idempotent) — no duplicate row is created
5.4 GET My Calendar — exactly one entry for it, no duplicates

exec: const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (raw && Array.isArray(raw.data) ? raw.data : []);
const matches = list.filter(i => i.id === oppId || (i.opportunity && i.opportunity.id === oppId));
pm.test('no duplicate calendar rows for the same item', () => pm.expect(matches.length).to.be.at.most(1));

item.name: 5.6 Save the event to My Calendar (volunteer) — events had no flag at all before BE-48
5.7 Re-fetch the event — is_saved_to_calendar + calendar_id now present (BE-48)

exec: pm.test('is_saved_to_calendar is true for an event', () => pm.expect(body.is_saved_to_calendar).to.eql(true));
pm.test('calendar_id is not null for an event', () => pm.expect(body.calendar_id).to.not.be.null);
